task.subject: A review-mode workflow that proposes bounded pull requests for unpinned workflow dependencies in githubnext/gh-cao
task.intent: Determine whether the dependency-pin remediation workflow activates only on deterministic unpinned-dependency findings, produces an attributable pull request when a safe pinning change is available, leaves already pinned or unevaluable workflows unchanged, and attains accepted remediation at the opportunity cutoff.
activationConditions: A deterministic workflow-smells observation in githubnext/gh-cao identifies smell-id unpinned-dependencies for .github/workflows/dependency-pin-remediation.md.

The workflow binds the run to one stable opportunity consisting of the target repository, affected workflow identity, unpinned-dependencies smell identity, and the configuration-evidence identity captured at activation.
No prior accepted remediation output covers that same stable opportunity.
requiredEffects: Evaluate only the dependency references identified by the bound opportunity and preserve the deterministic finding and run provenance.

When immutable replacements can be established safely, emit at most one review-mode pull request in githubnext/gh-cao that pins those references without broadening workflow permissions or rollout authority.
When a safe immutable replacement cannot be established, produce no durable repository change and retain the missing or insufficient evidence state for operator review.
noopConditions: The affected dependency is already pinned to an immutable commit or digest when evaluated.
The finding is stale, duplicate, outside githubnext/gh-cao, or already covered by an accepted pull request for the same stable opportunity.
The workflow cannot establish an immutable replacement from accepted repository evidence without guessing a revision or changing unrelated workflow behavior.
successConditions: Every eligible run is attributable to exactly one stable unpinned-dependency opportunity and does not widen repository scope.
A required effect is successful only when the pull-request outcome for the same opportunity is accepted in githubnext/gh-cao; run success alone is insufficient.
The operator can inspect activation evidence, run provenance, pull-request disposition, actionable exceptions, and the native attainment metric without treating missing evidence as zero.
uncertainties: A workflow-smells observation may be repeated while the underlying configuration opportunity is unchanged.
A successful run may intentionally no-op because a safe immutable replacement is unavailable.
Pending, rejected, ignored, or cross-repository pull-request outcomes do not establish accepted remediation.
A null attainment observation remains missing evidence and must not be converted to numeric zero.

opportunity.identity: target repository + affected workflow identity + unpinned-dependencies smell identity + activation configuration-evidence identity
opportunity.binding: Each hypothetical workflow run binds to exactly one opportunity before evaluation; repeated observations of unchanged configuration retain the same opportunity instead of creating new attainment credit.

acceptedEvidence: A deterministic workflow-smells row with smell-id unpinned-dependencies for the bound repository and affected workflow.
The attributed workflow run and its run link for the same bound opportunity.
An outcomes row in githubnext/gh-cao with outcome-category pull-request and outcome-state accepted, attributable to that run and opportunity.

orderedMetrics.definition: 1 when the bound opportunity has an accepted attributable pull-request outcome in githubnext/gh-cao by the cutoff; 0 only after maturation when eligible evidence is complete and no accepted outcome exists.

operationalValue.maturationRule: Assess attainment at the earlier of an accepted attributable pull-request observation or seven complete UTC days after the bound run finishes, using evidence through that cutoff.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Publish 0 only after the maturation cutoff when the opportunity, eligible run, target repository, and complete outcome search are all evidenced and no accepted attributable pull request exists.
operationalValue.missingEvidenceRule: Publish null before maturation or whenever opportunity identity, run attribution, repository match, outcome coverage, or accepted-state evidence is missing, partial, unavailable, or contradictory.

baseline.cutoff: The opportunity-specific maturation cutoff; synthetic design tasks have no immutable comparable pre-adoption baseline.

operationalValue.preservation: Preserve the upstream metric ID, ordering, native finite value or null, ratio unit, higher-is-better direction, opportunity cutoff, and evidence state exactly as published by gh-aw.
